threshold_selection: maximize validation detection F1 subject to sample FAR <= 0.01; fixed 3 consecutive alarms for episodes
selection_metric: mean of validation diagnosis macro F1 and validation detection F1; average over three seeds
test_policy: lock all candidates and thresholds before comparing on official Test; no post-test tuning
comparison_note: all models use identical fixed sample endpoints beginning at sample 20, every 10 samples; primary selected model additionally evaluated at every eligible sample
